_about: Anchor sources for the AirBorder report. The bibliography may hold only these keys: at most max_anchor_papers authoritative peer-reviewed conference papers, plus the project's own materials (interview/survey records, evaluation instruments, verification records) that cannot be reproduced in full in the report. Appendix-only sources are not cited. Checked by Scripts/reporting/check_citations.py. Set approved to true once the authors confirm the anchors. Anchors are chosen by the authors from Report/ANCHOR-CANDIDATES.md; Report/ANCHOR-MAP.md maps each anchor to the claims it supports. On 2026-11-11 the authors raised the cap from 3 to 7 anchor papers, chose not to cite external data sources, and asked for mostly AI-era anchors (three earlier papers: Fernandes 2018, Lim 2009, Amershi 2019).
